_doc: Leaguemate tendency profiles (plan, 'Leaguemate tendency profiles').
One entry per draft seat 1..12; seat 8 is you and is ignored by the
opponent model. Defaults are NEUTRAL so everything works untouched;
fill in what you actually know and the MC opponent model + live
need prediction sharpen accordingly.
name:          display label for the pick log / opponent rail.
adpDiscipline: 0..1 — 0 = wild reacher, 1 = strict ADP drafter.
0.5 = neutral (default Plackett-Luce temperature).
positionBias:  multiplicative pos weights, e.g. {"RB": 1.2} for a
known RB-heavy drafter. {} = neutral.
homerTeams:    NFL team codes they overdraft, e.g. ["DAL"].
reachRounds:   rounds where they historically reach, e.g. [1, 2].
archetypes.mix: per-DRAFT seat strategies. Each simulated draft, every
seat independently draws one archetype from this
weighted mix (weights are normalized). Names resolve to
built-in strategies or public/data/strategies.json
specs; the archetype's multipliers tilt that seat's
pick sampling and its constraints act as soft masks
(e.g. a zero_rb seat avoids RB in R1-3). Delete the
block (or set mix to null) to disable — behavior then
reverts exactly to the tendency-only model.
params:        optional global overrides for the sampler (tauScale,
discSpread, window, tauWindow, needAwareShare,
jitterSd, homerBoost, reachTau, caps). Calibration
(tools/calibrate.mjs) writes its fitted values here.
params.archetypeGamma:  exponent on archetype multipliers (w *= m^g).
1 = legacy; 3 makes a wr_heavy seat actually LOOK
WR-heavy instead of barely tilting the softmax.
params.earlyTauThrough / earlyTauScale:  rounds 1..through get
tau *= scale — real rooms draft near-chalk early.
(0, 1) = legacy off; (2, 0.55) = sharp rounds 1-2.
seats[].archetype:  OPTIONAL fixed strategy name for that seat (set
from the Sim Lab Room editor). A fixed seat skips the
per-draft mix draw and always plays that strategy;
names resolve like mix names (built-ins +
strategies.json). Absent = draw from the mix.
